title: PerformanceConfig
description:
Configuration of a latency run. Its canonical digest is the run's
`config_hash`.

baseline.description: The build every direction is relative to (arm A and its A/A control).

batch_invocations.description: Invocations per batch. A sample is the batch time per invocation.

chunk_bytes.description: Chunk size in bytes; used by the `chunked` shape.

shapes.description: Shapes to measure each workload in. Sorted, unique.

toolchain.description: Toolchain the subjects were built with. Sorted by name.

warmup_invocations.description: Untimed invocations per arm and workload before measuring.

InputDelivery.description: How a scanner command receives the input.

oneOf.description: The input is written to the command's standard input.

The input is written to a file and its path replaces the `{input}`
argument.

max_diagnostic_bytes.description: Largest diagnostic stream read per invocation (never retained).

max_input_bytes.description: Largest generated input per workload, in bytes.

max_response_bytes.description: Largest response read per invocation before the process is killed.

timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock timeout per invocation, in milliseconds.

PerfSubject.description: One scanner build under test: an external command.

args.description:
Arguments. With `delivery = file`, exactly one is the literal `{input}`.
Operator input; recorded and hashed.

delivery.description: How the input reaches the command.

id.description: Subject id, unique within the run.

ok_exit_codes.description:
Exit codes that count as a completed scan. Scanners that exit non-zero
when they find something list that code here; any other code, a signal
or a timeout is a failed invocation.

program.description: Executable path. Operator input; recorded and hashed.

revision.description: Source revision of the build, when it was built from a Git commit.

sha256.description: Required SHA-256 of the executable. A mismatch refuses the run.

version.description: Version label of the build (a release or a revision abbreviation).

ScanShape.description: Whether the scanner receives each workload whole or in chunks.

oneOf.description: One invocation over the whole input.

One invocation per chunk of at most `chunk_bytes`, split at line
boundaries; a sample is the sum over the chunks.

ToolchainEntry.description: A named toolchain component, recorded for reproduction.

WorkloadId.description:
A generated synthetic workload. The generator for each id is deterministic
and lives in `credential-eval-perf`; its output is identified by digest.

oneOf.description: Ordinary text with one non-ASCII character at the end.
Non-ASCII text on every line.
Ordinary text with one invisible (zero-width) character.
Invisible characters throughout.

Assignment lines whose value is also a standalone token shape, so more
than one detector claims the same range.

Secret-bearing lines with invisible characters inside the value, so
every reported range crosses a normalization seam.
The same short log line, repeated.
A few very long single-line assignments.

Assignment lines, densely, so a bounded scanner exhausts its budget
early in the input.
32-character alphanumeric values under one key.
Five keys and five value shapes.
Cloud secret-manager references and placeholders.
One `otpauth://` URI per line.
One `otpauth://` URI inside about 74 KB of ordinary log text.
One synthetic storage connection string.
100 storage connection strings, one per line.
One segment that repeats the same account-key field 100 times.
Ordinary log lines with no connection string.
Tokens on separate lines, none overlapping.
As `overlap-disjoint`, with one overlapping pair in the middle.
Every token overlaps exactly one other.
Every token overlaps its neighbours.

units.description: Size in generator units (lines, records or tokens; see the generator).
